note: Produced with R version 4.3.3 (2024-02-29) using base R only. Rate ratios: exact conditional CI from poisson.test(c(a_j, a_ref), c(n_j, n_ref)); log-scale (Wald) CI exp(log RR +/- z sqrt(1/a_j + 1/a_ref)). Rate difference: (r_j - r_ref) +/- z sqrt(a_j/n_j^2 + a_ref/n_ref^2), per 100,000. Index of disparity (Pearcy & Keppel 2002): mean over non-reference groups of |r_j - r_ref|, divided by r_ref, times 100. Between-group variance (Harper et al.): sum p_j (r_j - mu)^2 with p_j = n_j/N and mu = sum p_j r_j (rates per 100,000); SE by the delta method sqrt(sum (2 p_j (r_j - mu))^2 a_j/n_j^2) (per 100,000 squared), checked by Monte Carlo (200,000 Poisson draws, seed 20261107). PAF: excess = sum(a) - r_ref * sum(n); PAF = excess / sum(a); CI on log(1 - PAF) with variance B/(a_ref * O), O = sum(a), B = O - a_ref.
